supporting_observations.claim: FILE-BLU-01 sent approximately 640 million client-side bytes through the proxy to ingest.cloudkeep-backup.com; Zeek records approximately the same outbound volume.

The transfer is attributed to C:\Program Files\Cloudkeep\agent.exe running as BLUEFIN\svc-arch, and the proxy records the Cloudkeep destination. The supplied inventory identifies this agent and offsite backup service as approved and notes that uploads of several hundred MB are expected.

The large transfer began at 13:50:22 UTC, several minutes later than the alert’s stated time around 13:46 UTC. The evidence supports a benign disposition for the observed large transfer, but does not precisely reconcile that timing difference.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy and Zeek records provide byte counts and destination information, but do not show the transferred files or their contents (T210-00372, T210-00374).
The supplied records do not precisely match the alert’s approximate 13:46 time; the large transfer is logged at 13:50:22 UTC (T210-00372, T210-00374).
The proxy records the client as user=-; process attribution comes from the endpoint records rather than an authenticated proxy identity (T210-00366, T210-00368, T210-00372, T210-00373).
claims_not_established: Whether the alert’s reported 13:46 time reflects a different clock, an approximate alert time, or a separate transfer.
Which files were transferred, whether they contained sensitive data, and whether the backup completed successfully at the application level.
additional_evidence_needed: If exact alert-to-event reconciliation is required, compare the original alert’s flow timestamp and byte count with the proxy and endpoint records.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: a Kerberos service-ticket request for svc-arch is recorded from public IP 91.219.236.174, followed by a svc-arch service logon on FILE-BLU-01. This is anomalous in the stated no-VPN environment, but the records do not establish that it caused the Cloudkeep transfer (T210-00335, T210-00336, T210-00337).
Separate ticket: FILE-BLU-01 accessed receiver.citrix.com using python-requests; the supplied inventory does not list this service as approved (T210-00213, T210-00214).

Separate ticket: ruth.moss initiated an RDP session to FILE-BLU-01, although the supplied practice says remote administration is only done from WS-KITO-01 (T210-00446, T210-00454, T210-00458, T210-00459).
